condition.d,1:
(
    NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM user_roles pv_off
      WHERE pv_off.user_id = $2 AND pv_off.disabled_at IS NOT NULL)
    AND (
    $1 = 'admin'
    OR (d.uploaded_by = $2 AND NOT d.library_scoped)
    OR EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM document_acl da
      WHERE da.document_id = d.id
        AND da.subject_type = 'user'
        AND lower(da.subject_id) IN (lower($3), lower($4))
        AND da.permission = ANY($5::text[])
        AND NOT (d.library_scoped AND lower(da.subject_id) IS NOT DISTINCT FROM d.uploaded_by::text)
    )
    OR (d.library_scoped AND (
         d.library_id IN (
           SELECT pv_lo.id FROM libraries pv_lo
            WHERE pv_lo.owner_id = $2
              AND (CASE WHEN $1 = 'contributor' THEN 'admin' ELSE 'read' END) = ANY($5::text[]))
      OR d.library_id IN (
           SELECT pv_lg.library_id FROM library_grants pv_lg
            WHERE pv_lg.folder_path = '' AND (CASE WHEN $1 = 'contributor' AND pv_lg.permission = 'write' THEN 'write' ELSE 'read' END) = ANY($5::text[]) AND ((pv_lg.subject_type = 'user' AND pv_lg.subject_email = (SELECT pv_ur.verified_email FROM user_roles pv_ur WHERE pv_ur.user_id = $2))
          OR (pv_lg.subject_type = 'group' AND pv_lg.group_id IN (
                SELECT pv_gm.group_id FROM group_members pv_gm WHERE lower(pv_gm.member_email) = (SELECT pv_ur.verified_email FROM user_roles pv_ur WHERE pv_ur.user_id = $2)))))
      OR EXISTS (
           SELECT 1 FROM library_grants pv_lf
            WHERE pv_lf.library_id = d.library_id AND pv_lf.folder_path <> ''
              AND starts_with(d.name, pv_lf.folder_path || '/')
              AND (CASE WHEN $1 = 'contributor' AND pv_lf.permission = 'write' THEN 'write' ELSE 'read' END) = ANY($5::text[]) AND ((pv_lf.subject_type = 'user' AND pv_lf.subject_email = (SELECT pv_ur.verified_email FROM user_roles pv_ur WHERE pv_ur.user_id = $2))
          OR (pv_lf.subject_type = 'group' AND pv_lf.group_id IN (
                SELECT pv_gm.group_id FROM group_members pv_gm WHERE lower(pv_gm.member_email) = (SELECT pv_ur.verified_email FROM user_roles pv_ur WHERE pv_ur.user_id = $2)))))
    ))
  ))
